subject: Request: service credit eligibility & telemetry bundle for Nov 27 outage
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <ops@payflux.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 18:12:00 -0000
Subject: Production outage 2026-11-27 — initial impact & credit inquiry

Hi Laura,

Wanted to flag a production impact we observed in our US-WEST region between ~16:02 and 16:47 UTC today. Users hit elevated 503s and elevated request latency to your text-generation endpoint (model: r-instruct-v2-small). Our payments flow had several failed checkout attempts; we saw a spike in retries and a handful of lost transactions.

Can Redwood confirm whether this window is considered downtime under our SLA and, if eligible, what the path for service credits would be? Samir is attaching a short telemetry bundle and the initial timeline in the CC.

We'd like confirmation of the impacted window and a tentative schedule for a joint postmortem. This is time-sensitive for our finance team (month-end).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Engineering Operations
Payflux Systems

Attachments: telemetry_bundle_usw2_20261127.tar.gz (attachment sent separately)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <ops@payflux.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 19:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production outage 2026-11-27 — initial impact & credit inquiry

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up and for the telemetry. I've looped in Diego (on-call infra lead) and Priyom (SLO adjudication) so we can triage quickly.

Quick answers up front:
- We're treating this as a potential availability degradation; need to validate the exact impacted window against our monitoring and your traces.
- If the request/503 counts meet the SLA availability definition, we will route this through the standard credit adjudication.

Actions I need from Payflux to speed adjudication:
1) Confirm exact cluster/region and a sample request id or two if available.
2) If you can share the full trace IDs and the telemetry bundle link (I see the tar.gz) that helps our evidence pull.
3) Would you be available for a 30-min sync tomorrow morning (Nov 28, 09:30 PT / 17:30 UTC) to align on windows and evidence?

We will prepare an initial evidence packet and a timeline draft prior to the meeting.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Reliability (Redwood Inference)
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 01:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production outage 2026-11-27 — initial impact & credit inquiry

Hi all — digging into the traces Elena provided. Preliminary notes:
- We see a control-plane failover event at 16:01:58 UTC that correlates with a short-lived spike in 5xx across a subset of hosts in the US-WEST pool.
- From our sampling, the request error-rate exceeds the SLA unavailability threshold between 16:02:10 and 16:45:52 UTC for tenant Payflux (tenant-id: pf-4782).
- There is evidence of request retry amplification on the client side after the initial failures; we'll need Payflux's retry logs to determine net transaction loss vs eventual success.

I'll assemble a raw trace bundle and a host-level timeline and attach to the postmortem doc. Priyom — please advise on the evidence threshold for entitlement in this case (control-plane failover vs regional capacity issues).

Diego
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Elena / Samir — thanks for joining the thread. Follow-ups and next steps: 

1) We've confirmed an initial candidate impacted window of 16:02:10–16:45:52 UTC based on our combined traces. Diego will publish the host-trace bundle to the shared Drive folder and include a short chronology.
2) Evidence we still need from Payflux to complete an entitlement determination:
   - Client-side retry logs for the affected checkout requests (sample request IDs)
   - Any ingest-side filtering or rate-limiting that might have affected retries
3) Proposed postmortem cadence: 60-minute joint RCA on Monday Nov 29 at 16:00 UTC. Please confirm availability; we'll circulate an agenda and the redwood-rca-outline-v1.docx beforehand.

If entitlement criteria are met we will calculate a prorated credit per the SLA and route to your finance contact. We'll also provide a remediation plan to reduce recurrence risk (control-plane hardening + ephemeral routing improvements).

Laura
